name: thinking-tools
description: Thinking-tool skills for harder, more honest AI assistance: board (adversarial multi-expert critique), premortem (name what could go wrong before committing to a plan), but-for-real (no success claims without actually running the thing), self-rate (grade your own draft before the user does), code-simplifier (clarity-preserving refactors of recent changes), weekly-automation-review (spot repetitive work worth automating — reads the cross-repo prompt log and per-repo memory indexes when the dev-hooks plugin is installed), commit-digest (pull applicable improvements from tracked external repos), adr (record significant architectural decisions with context, reasoning, and consequences), and quiz-me (quiz the developer on recent code changes to build genuine comprehension via active recall).
